crossRefs.note: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat…
Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth…
When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand?…

translations.web: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
translations.bsb: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
translations.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
translations.asv: All thy trees and the fruit of thy ground shall the locust possess.
